column1: # Datasets manifest — one row per study to fetch+process.
# The reconciler (reconcile.py --manifest) and driver (run_batch.sh) read this.
# Copy to config/manifest.tsv and edit for your studies.
#   accession    GEO/SRA accession (GSE / SRP / PRJNA / SRX / SRR / GSM).
#   feature      Gene (scRNA, exonic) or GeneFull (snRNA, intron-inclusive).
#   workdir      Output tree for this study. Relative paths resolve from $PWD
#                (the repo root); absolute paths are used as-is.
#   notes        (optional) free text; chemistry/strand ride in the per-sample
# Lines beginning with # are ignored. Chemistry is auto-detected per sample at
# sheet-build time, so per-study configs only override workdir/samples_tsv/feature.
